selected_sample.description: The pale thin lettering "mini- stero educa- zione nazio- nale" (ministero educazione nazionale) inside the dark green panel of the obelisk cover: six lines, 28 letters and 3 hyphens
why: it is the lettering that the owner named: the pale thin lettering inside the dark green panel
it is the only sample of this lettering in the supplied photos at this size (letter height about 62 photo pixels, stroke about 8 photo pixels)
flat two-colour print: the letters are the paper colour inside the green panel; all 31 shapes are complete and separate
the six lines give 14 different letters (a c d e i l m n o r s t u z) and the hyphen
selected_sample.limits: The lettering is drawn by hand: repeated letters (a e i n o z and the hyphen) are not identical, and the font holds one observed shape for each letter. The letters c, d, l, m, r, s, t and u occur once. The letter i has no dot in this lettering. The six lines are not exactly parallel, so each line is measured on its own baseline. The sample shows no space between words and no capitals.
not_to_be_confused_with: the black title lettering "opera balilla" on the same cover
the capitals MINISTERO EDUCAZIONE NAZIONALE on the burgundy cover (the Balilla cover capitals face)
the numeral XII in the same panel
the small text lettering of the inside table (photo assets/HXwNYdeXgAE-ocC.jpg), which has the same forms of s and z at a letter height of about 12 photo pixels; it is not used

supplied_close_photo.relation: It is the same exposure as assets/HXwNXsUWEAALJek.jpg, reduced to 5/6 of its size. The font is traced from the larger copy. The font file is also compared with the close photo.

labels.extrapolated-derived: extrapolated: mirrored, turned or extended from a traced glyph
labels.extrapolated-constructed: extrapolated: one-weight construction from the measured stroke, letter height, ascender and descender

smoothing.model: each run of an outline between two corners is smoothed along its length; corners keep a light smoothing; the unit is one rectified unit, about one photo pixel

spacing.model: gap = right bearing of the left letter + left bearing of the right letter; straight sides share one value, round sides share one value, other sides have their own value; least squares on 21 gaps between letters; the right side of r has the bearing of t, and the measured distance r-o is a kerning pair
